Class Histo2DData

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.pdata.Histo2DData
public final class Histo2DData extends Object
Container class for 2D histogram (heatmap) data.

Data coordinates are binned into a uniform grid of nx * ny cells over [xmin, xmax] and [ymin, ymax].

Bin conventions

  • Bins are uniform in x and y.
  • Values strictly below min or strictly above max are out of range.
  • Values exactly equal to max are included in the last bin.

Under/over handling

Like HistoData, values outside the range are not binned; instead they are counted in under/over counters. In 2D there are edge regions and corners (both x and y out of range).

Threading

This class is safe to fill from a worker thread while the EDT paints by using snapshotBins() in the painter. All mutations and snapshots are guarded by an internal lock.

    • fill

      public void fill(double x, double y, double weight)
      Fill the histogram.

      Out-of-range points increment under/over counters; in-range points increment the appropriate bin. Weight may be any finite value (including negative), but note that negative weights make "max" less meaningful.

    • percentile

      public double percentile(double datax, double datay)
      Get the percentile rank of the bin containing the given data coordinate.

      Percentile is computed over the distribution of occupied bins (non-zero, finite bin values). The returned value is in the range [0, 100] where 0 means "empty or no occupied bins" and 100 means "at or above the maximum occupied bin".

      Parameters:
      datax - data x coordinate
      datay - data y coordinate
      Returns:
      percentile rank in [0, 100]

    • localMean3x3

      public double localMean3x3(double datax, double datay)
      Compute the local 3x3 neighborhood average around the bin containing the given data coordinate.

      The neighborhood includes the center bin and all valid in-range neighbors. The average is computed over finite values; non-finite values are ignored.

      Parameters:
      datax - data x coordinate
      datay - data y coordinate
      Returns:
      local 3x3 average, or 0 if the coordinate is out of range or no finite bins are available
